Palworld Mount Speed Comparison

All ridable Pals ranked by sprint speed (258 Pals). Higher sprint speed = faster travel. Data from the Palworld 1.0 roster.

#PalSprintRunTransportSwim
Quick picks: Jetragon is the fastest flying mount (3300). Panthalus (3000) and Necromus/Paladius (~1900/1800) are top ground options. Saddle unlock levels vary — check each Pal's saddle requirements in-game.
